program.name: Everyday Athlete
program.subject: Balanced week
program.blurb: Strength, a hard conditioning block and balance drills: what a person who moves well every day trains.
program.about: The three things an everyday athlete needs: strength, a strong engine and balance. Each day lifts with dumbbells or a kettlebell, then sweats through a circuit, an AMRAP or an EMOM, and finishes with balance drills on one leg. The upper day closes with abs. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III adds reps, the conditioning adds reps at both levels, and balance work adds reps too. Good for anyone who wants to stay fit for whatever the week throws at them.
program.split: Legs / upper / full body: lift, sweat, balance
program.gear: A pair of dumbbells or a kettlebell, and a sturdy chair or couch for the balance work.
